mapper.update: MERGE INTO userRegion u USING ( SELECT #{userIdx} AS userIdx, #{regionType} AS regionType FROM DUAL ) d ON (u.userIdx = d.userIdx AND u.regionType = d.regionType) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET regionCode = #{regionCode}, authDate = SYSDATE, is_authenticated = 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( regionIdx, userIdx, regionCode, regionType, is_active, is_authenticated, authDate ) VALUES ( userRegion_seq.NEXTVAL, d.userIdx, #{regionCode}, d.regionType, CASE WHEN d.regionType = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1, SYSDATE )
